data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 银杏长椅边的热茶
data.description: 银杏树下的木长椅上，阿尔托莉雅穿藏蓝牛角扣呢大衣，象牙白围巾垂在胸前，绿蓝格纹中裙整齐铺在并拢的膝上。她双手捧着暖茶纸杯，低头闻茶香，杯口蒸汽在斜阳中显得很轻。椅端放着合拢的小食纸袋，近处木条与落叶清楚可见；石砖步道从椅背后绕过，低矮石栏将步道与更远的草坪分开。左后方夕照穿过黄叶，勾亮围巾和盘发上的蓝丝带，杯子与手指保持柔和亮面，长椅、鞋边和树下各有落影。
data.location: 秋日公园银杏树下长椅，后方弯曲步道越过低石栏通向草坪
data.action: 双膝并拢坐在长椅上，双手捧暖茶纸杯，低头闻茶香并露出浅笑。
data.lighting: golden-hour sun from the back left through ginkgo leaves; warm rim on scarf and blue hair ribbon
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated portrait with knees, bench and curving path visible
data.promptProse: A narrow curl of steam rises between Artoria Pendragon's cupped hands as she lowers her face to smell the tea. She sits with knees together on the ginkgo-shaded bench, wearing a navy wool duffle coat, ivory scarf and green-and-navy tartan skirt. Her braided blonde bun retains its blue ribbon. A closed paper snack bag rests at the bench end, beside clearly separated wooden slats and fallen yellow leaves. Behind the backrest, a stone-paved path curves past a low railing toward the open lawn. The eye-level medium view includes her knees and the path's bend. Low sun from the back left catches the scarf's wool fibers, ribbon and tea steam; light reflected from the pale paving keeps hands readable. Leaf shadows cross the slats, with grounded shade beneath the bench and boots.
